content_html:

Wed, August 12, 2026 at 4:02 AM EDT 6 min read

Key Points

  • Interested in Check Point Software Technologies Ltd.? Here are five stocks we like better.

  • AI cybersecurity spending could accelerate in 2027 as customers shift from experimental AI budgets to dedicated funding. Check Point expects rising AI-driven network traffic and demand for protections such as its AI Network Firewall.

  • Check Point's go-to-market transition disrupted second-quarter execution, but management expects improvement in the second half. The company views the third quarter as a trough and says its fourth-quarter pipeline is particularly strong, while planning to add roughly 150 net employees by year-end.

  • The company is expanding its platform strategy through products such as CTEM, SASE and AI security offerings, while keeping larger acquisitions under consideration. Management said M&A is not required to achieve double-digit growth but could accelerate progress.

  • Time to Buy These Up-and-Coming Software Firms?

Check Point Software Technologies (NASDAQ:CHKP) sees 2027 as a potentially significant year for artificial intelligence-related cybersecurity spending as customers move from experimentation toward more deliberate budgeting, according to Global Head of Investor Relations Kip Meintzer.

Speaking at an investor event, Meintzer said organizations had redirected spending from other budget areas to fund AI initiatives during the current year. However, as companies prepare annual operating plans for next year, he expects more dedicated AI spending, including investments in AI security.

"Without security, you're in a little heap of trouble," Meintzer said, adding that companies and AI model developers have increasingly recognized the risks associated with deploying AI without adequate protections.

Go-to-Market Changes and Second-Half Outlook

Meintzer said Check Point's second-quarter execution during its go-to-market transition "could've been better," though he said the company now has a better handle on the third and fourth quarters. He pointed to the company's guidance and pipeline indicators as evidence that conditions are moving in the right direction.

The go-to-market changes are designed to focus more resources on larger customers and new-logo opportunities. Existing large accounts are receiving more dedicated account-manager coverage, while sales "hunters" pursuing new logos are being given multiyear contracts rather than being measured solely on a one-year timetable.

content_html_zh:
市场节奏

2026 年 8 月 12 日星期三，美国东部时间凌晨 4:02 阅读 6 分钟

要点

  • 对 Check Point 软件技术有限公司感兴趣？ 这是我们更喜欢的五只股票。
  • 随着客户从实验性人工智能预算转向专用资金，人工智能网络安全支出可能会在 2027 年加速。 Check Point 预计人工智能驱动的网络流量和对人工智能网络防火墙等保护的需求将不断增加。
  • Check Point 的上市转型扰乱了第二季度的执行，但管理层预计下半年情况会有所改善。 该公司将第三季度视为低谷，并表示其第四季度的渠道特别强劲，同时计划在年底前净增加约 150 名员工。
  • 该公司正在通过 CTEM、SASE 和 AI 安全产品等产品扩展其平台战略，同时仍在考虑进行更大规模的收购。 管理层表示，并购并不需要实现两位数的增长，但可以加速进展。
  • 是时候购买这些新兴软件公司了吗？

Check Point Software Technologies（纳斯达克股票代码：CHKP）全球投资者关系主管 Kip Meintzer 表示，随着客户从实验转向更审慎的预算，2027 年可能是人工智能相关网络安全支出的重要一年。

梅因泽尔在一次投资者活动上发表讲话时表示，各组织已将其他预算领域的支出重新调整为今年的人工智能计划。 然而，随着公司准备明年的年度运营计划，他预计会有更多专门的人工智能支出，包括对人工智能安全的投资。

“如果没有安全性，你就会遇到很多麻烦，”Meintzer 说，并补充说，公司和人工智能模型开发人员越来越认识到在没有足够保护的情况下部署人工智能所带来的风险。

上市变化和下半年展望

Meintzer 表示，Check Point 在进入市场的过渡过程中第二季度的执行情况“本来可以更好”，不过他表示该公司现在对第三和第四季度的情况有了更好的处理。 他指出，该公司的指导和管道指标证明情况正在朝着正确的方向发展。

进入市场的变化旨在将更多资源集中在更大的客户和新标识机会上。 现有的大客户正在接受更多专门的客户经理的覆盖，而追求新徽标的销售“猎人”则获得多年期合同，而不是仅仅根据一年的时间表进行衡量。
